high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "arth_mantra." The post features a graphic with a "Did You Know?" header in bold green letters. Below the header, there is a statement in black text that reads: "After Independence, Pakistan used Indian Rupee notes stamped with 'Pakistan', until it could print enough of its own currency." The graphic includes a magnified view of an Indian Rupee note, specifically highlighting the area where the word "Government of India" is printed.
